description: A standalone Python script for testing Krisp VIVA turn detection on real audio files, including audio processing, turn event detection, and output of turn probabilities.

methods.name: validate_model_path
methods.description: Checks that the environment variable for the model path is set and the file exists.

methods.name: analyze_audio_file
methods.description: Performs turn detection analysis on the provided audio file, outputs turn events, speech segments, and optionally saves turn probabilities.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments and initiates the audio analysis process.
